task_title: XML spec source + targeted cross-file assembly: sections, attributes, references and verification
task_criteria: AC1 the versioned XML schema declares stable block ids plus the kind, applies-to, status/version and verification-method attributes and the grammar is actually consulted: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python auger.py spec validate specs exits 0 printing 'spec: 3 document(s), 12 block(s), 7 reference(s) ok', and grep -c 'xs:attribute name=' specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd prints 36. PROOF: run both commands and quote the exit code, the counts line and the attribute count. FAILIF: validate exits non-zero or refuses, the counts differ from 3/12/7, or the schema declares fewer attributes than those four AC dimensions.

AC2 a CLI selects blocks by id and attributes and assembles at least two XML files in deterministic order preserving source ids and citations: two consecutive cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python auger.py spec assemble tests/fixtures/xml/specs --kind requirement --applies-to auger.export --format json runs produce byte-identical output (identical sha256) with 5 blocks whose source fields cite export.xml#ID and shared.xml#ID, split 3 matched plus 2 dependency. PROOF: quote both sha256 values, the block count, the distinct source documents, and the matched-versus-dependency split. FAILIF: the hashes differ, fewer than 5 blocks are emitted, only one source document appears, or a block carries no id-bearing source citation.

AC3 refusals are typed and emit no partial document across the five required classes: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -k refusals_are_typed -q passes with the parametrisation covering unresolved-reference, duplicate-id, reference-cycle, unsupported-schema-version and invalid verification metadata, and the test asserts the --out target does not exist afterwards. PROOF: quote the pytest summary and the collected case ids. FAILIF: the test fails or errors, one of the five refusal classes is missing from the matrix, or the no-partial-document assertion is gone.

AC4 the default Markdown export golden is unchanged and XML selection emits only the requested blocks plus their explicit dependencies: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -k 'markdown_export_is_unchanged or selection_matches_the_golden or selects_only_requested_blocks' -q reports 3 passed with none deselected. PROOF: quote the pytest summary line. FAILIF: any of the three tests fails or is deselected by the -k expression.

AC5 the decision record carries a ch:trace row with a repository-relative anchor and the guard/CI arm runs the new tests: cd /home/kara/auger && grep -c 'ch:trace row=AUG-118' docs/SPEC-003-xml-specs.md is at least 1, grep -c 'tests/test_xml_specs.py' tests/gate.sh is at least 1, and .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py -k 'spec_doc_records_the_decision or gate_runs_these_tests' -q reports 2 passed. PROOF: quote both grep counts and the pytest summary. FAILIF: the trace marker is absent, the gate pytest arm does not name tests/test_xml_specs.py, or either test fails.
